class.name: BudgetBankNative
class.brief_description: Native iOS features for BudgetBank (BudgetBank fork).
class.description: Review prompt, Plaid Link (LinkKit), and the iOS keyboard's space-bar caret, which Godot 4.6 does not forward. Used by BudgetBank's Native.gd.

method.name: install_keyboard_caret_hook
method.description: Forwards caret moves made with the iOS keyboard's space-bar trackpad as [signal keyboard_caret_moved]. Returns [code]true[/code] when installed. iOS only.

method.name: open_plaid_link
method.description: Opens Plaid Link over the game with a link token from the server. The result arrives as [signal plaid_link_success] or [signal plaid_link_exit]. Returns [code]false[/code] if Link can't open. iOS only.

method.name: ping
method.description: Returns [code]"pong"[/code]. Smoke test that the module loaded.

method.name: request_review
method.description: Asks iOS to show the App Store review prompt; iOS decides whether it appears. iOS only.

signal.name: keyboard_caret_moved
signal.description: The caret moved to [param column] (characters); [param length] > 0 when text is selected.

signal.name: plaid_link_exit
signal.description: Plaid Link closed without connecting a bank. [param error_code] is empty when the player closed it.

signal.name: plaid_link_success
signal.description: Plaid Link connected a bank. Send [param public_token] to the server to finish the connection.
